target.host: Namecheap Stellar Business (cPanel, CloudLinux, Phusion Passenger)
target.runtime: Node.js >= 20.9 via cPanel Setup Node.js App (selector path /opt/alt/alt-nodejsNN/root/usr/bin/node)
target.reverseProxy: Passenger (reverse port binding; app must .listen() once on the supplied PORT)
target.persistentData: Owner-provisioned managed PostgreSQL/PostGIS reached over outbound TLS; no canonical database file lives on cPanel
target.backups: Managed-provider/operator authority; a verified receipt is required before migration

artifact.builder: deploy/namecheap/build-artifact.mjs (off-server ONLY; webpack standalone; Turbopack banned per 2026-07-23 incident)

identity.buildTime: release.json + receipt.json at artifact root, gitSha = full 40-hex commit
identity.runtime: GET /api/release -> RELEASE_SHA_PRESENT with the exact SHA; 503 RELEASE_SHA_MISSING/INVALID when absent or malformed; never fabricated
identity.tests: apps/web/tests/release-sha.test.mjs + isolated runtime test inside the builder

conditional: prisma/migrations/** — shipped only when the exact reviewed names and migration.sql SHA-256 digests match prisma/migration-manifest.json; never authored by the builder

commands.deploy: Upload deploy.sh plus verify-owner-artifact-input.sh, then run: sh ~/uploads/deploy.sh orderweeddc-<full-40-char-sha>.tar.gz <trusted-tarball-sha256>. The script snapshots and enforces checksum, archive structure, full-SHA release identity, receipt, and isolated-runtime proof before swapping code. verify-and-deploy.sh remains the gated download + deploy path.
commands.initializeDatabase: CANA_PRE_MIGRATION_BACKUP_RECEIPT=<provider-receipt> sh migrate.sh && /opt/alt/alt-nodejs20/root/usr/bin/node scripts/init-production-db.mjs   (empty owner-provisioned PostgreSQL only; creates one canonical brand and zero retailers)
commands.migrate: CANA_PRE_MIGRATION_BACKUP_RECEIPT=<provider-receipt> sh migrate.sh   (requires DATABASE_URL + DIRECT_URL and committed migrations)
commands.rollback: sh <app-home>/rollback.sh   (code-only swap to previous; database never touched)
commands.readinessCheck: OWD_EXPECTED_SHA=<sha> sh readycheck.sh <base-url>   (health + provenance + SHA equality + render)
commands.smokeTest: sh smoke-test.sh <base-url>   (full read-only battery; writes an environment-labelled receipt)
commands.workerOnce: /opt/alt/alt-nodejs20/root/usr/bin/node worker.mjs --once health   (cron tick: independent health job; mkdir lock; SIGTERM-graceful)
commands.workerCron: */5 * * * * mkdir -p ~/orderweeddc-backups && cd <app-home>/current && OWD_BACKUP_DIR=~/orderweeddc-backups WORKER_HEALTH_URL=<owner-url> /opt/alt/alt-nodejs20/root/usr/bin/node worker.mjs --once health >> ~/orderweeddc-backups/cron.out 2>&1
commands.restoreBackup: Provider/operator procedure; the shipped worker refuses to fabricate a local-file managed-PostgreSQL backup

environment.manifest: deploy/namecheap/ENV_MANIFEST.md (names only — values are owner-supplied at the cPanel panel, never in git)

receiptDiscipline.rule: NO staging receipt may state or imply that production is live.
receiptDiscipline.enforcement: smoke-test.sh labels every receipt 'staging' unless OWD_ENVIRONMENT=production AND OWD_CONFIRM_PRODUCTION=1; staging receipts carry an explicit no-production-claim sentence.
